## Bundled fonts

egui embeds its default fonts in the PCB-CAM binary. The MIT, SIL Open Font
License 1.1 and Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 texts above cover the `epaint_default_fonts`
package; the font-specific copyright notices follow.
